title: ImageRepresentationV1
description: Proposed concrete encoded representation of an image, containing only intrinsic technical metadata for that encoded form. Contextual usage semantics such as display or thumbnail belong to ImageRepresentationUseV1, while provenance such as original or derived is intentionally a separate concern. This schema is not yet canonical.

mediaType.description: Media type of the encoded byte sequence, for example image/jpeg, image/png, or image/webp.

width.description: Pixel width of this encoded image representation when known.

height.description: Pixel height of this encoded image representation when known.
